DraftOutput.subject: Acme's revenue accounting hire
DraftOutput.body:
Hi Priya,

Noticed Acme Analytics is hiring a Senior Revenue Accountant to own multi-processor reconciliation. That usually means reconciliation across processors is becoming a real time sink for the finance team. LedgerLens automates revenue reconciliation across payment processors, so the team can close the books faster without adding more manual matching as volumes grow. If that role is meant to tame month-end, would it be useful to compare notes on how other finance teams approach it?

Best,
[Your name]
